en: The material in this mask is expelling pure darkness.
An ancient mask fashioned into the face of a great being.
Meant to make you look big and tough.
Its durable visor strikes an authoritative appearance.
The sturdy design of these legs help you stand firm.
A shiny chestpiece made almost entirely of platinum.
ko: 거의 전체가 플래티넘으로 만들어진 반짝이는 흉갑.

en: Used by Sunborn warriors to achieve powered flight. If only its avolite crystals weren't inert...
A protective breastplate only bestowed to Kluex's chosen warriors.
ko: 클루엑스의 선택받은 전사에게만 하사되는 수호 흉갑.

en: An intimidating mask fashioned in the image of Kluex.
Protective greaves only granted to Kluex's most worthy.
ko: 클루엑스의 가장 자격 있는 자에게만 부여되는 수호 그리브.

en: An advanced EPP module that grants physical resistance through an energy shield.
Originally a water balloon, just with poison added.
A blue flashlight! Its light fills you with hope.
A orange flashlight! Makes the world glimmer like gold.
A pink flashlight! Spread the love.
This forge utilizes melted down Impervium to reinforce armor pieces.
ko: 이 대장간은 녹여낸 임페르비움으로 갑옷 조각을 강화한다.
